english.title: Obtain access to uncleared goods by means of a pipe-line without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),without the authority of a proper officer or for just and sufficient cause, obtained access to goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), which were

(A)_[in]_
(B)_[in the course of conveyance by]_

a pipe-line approved under section 24 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24(5)(b) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
